messages.subject: It worked
messages.body:
I logged in this morning.

My messages were there. Only mine.

She tried hers too. Both accounts work. Support sent us separate confirmation numbers.

I checked twice.

Thank you for not taking the easy answer.

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body:
I think we should finally introduce ourselves properly.

We spent weeks being told we were the same person. Turns out we have very little in common.

Except the name, apparently.
